description: One check from the workspace's price history with its whole answer, as price_from_capture first gave it: the item and its condition, the price, range and confidence, the reason, prices read off tags or listings, what would make it sharper, and the listing (selling) or message to the seller (buying). check_id is the id from list_price_checks, or the check_id price_from_capture returned. The photos, files, links and text sent are never kept, only the answer. Another workspace's id, or an unknown one, is a 404. Changes nothing. Until price history is switched on for your workspace it answers 404 not_released. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

check_id.description: The check's id, from list_price_checks or the check_id price_from_capture returned.

name: get_price_check
